# ibiblio.org

> > ibiblio.org is a public digital library and archive hosting diverse collections including religious texts, historical documents, and open-source resources.

This particular section of ibiblio.org features extensive Bahá'í Faith religious materials, including prayers and writings by Bahá'u'lláh, The Báb, `Abdu'l-Bahá, Shoghi Effendi, and guidance from The Universal House of Justice. The collection serves as a reference resource for spiritual texts and prayer compilations.

## Key Topics

- Bahá'u'lláh
- The Báb
- `Abdu'l-Bahá
- Shoghi Effendi
- The Universal House of Justice
- Bahá'í prayers
- Obligatory prayers
- Religious texts
- Prayer collections
- Spiritual assistance
- Mark Towfiq

## Bahá'í Prayer Collections

- [BAHÁ'Í PRAYERS, Pages 256-259](http://www.ibiblio.org/Bahai/Texts/EN/BP): Bahá'í prayer collection featuring texts by Bahá'u'lláh and other figures
